title: Week 7
priceNote: Prices are estimates from typical Aldi and Publix shelf prices and do not include tax. New Year's week: a lighter Greek-style week after the holidays, with black-eyed peas and greens for luck on New Year's Day.
allergyNote: Nothing on this plan contains tree nuts or fish. Smoked sausage and cornbread mix are normally nut-free, but check the labels for a 'may contain tree nuts' line if your allergy is strict.
weekendNote: First weekend of the new year. Nothing is required. A bowl of Hoppin' John and a wedge of cornbread are waiting for Saturday's lunch.

have.name: Chipotle peppers in adobo
have.note: the rest of the can, in the freezer

mon.heads: Everything today comes from Sunday's prep. Tonight's soup covers Wednesday and Thursday lunches.

tue.heads: Dinner is 10 minutes in the cast iron after pickleball.

wed.heads: Tonight, move the 2 frozen chicken portions to the fridge for Thursday and Friday.

thu.heads: New Year's Eve. Dinner is a 15-minute flatbread after pickleball.

fri.heads: Happy New Year. Black-eyed peas and greens for luck, dinner for two. It makes Saturday's lunch.

prep.title: Sunday batch prep
prep.makes: About 9 portions of lemon chicken, a tray of roasted vegetables, lemon rice, whipped feta, 9 egg muffins and 6 baked oatmeal cups
steps: Marinate the chicken while the oven heats to 425°F.
Roast the chicken on one sheet pan and the zucchini, peppers and red onion on another, 25 minutes, swapping the pans halfway.
Cook the lemon rice.
Whip the feta, yogurt, lemon and garlic smooth.
Turn the oven down to 350°F. Bake the egg muffins and the oatmeal cups together for 20 to 25 minutes.
Slice the chicken and portion it: 2 for bowls, 2 for soup, 1 for quesadillas, 2 for gyros in the fridge.
Freeze the other 2 (Thursday's flatbread and Friday's bowl). Cooked chicken keeps 3 to 4 days, so the end of the week waits in the freezer.
Pack 2 Greek bowls. Keep the whipped feta in a jar.

prep.title: Wednesday night
prep.makes: Gyros for two, with the end of the week ready
steps: Move the 2 frozen chicken portions to the fridge.
Warm the pitas and chicken and build the gyros.

lemon-chicken.name: Sheet-pan Greek lemon chicken
steps: Stir the zest and juice of 2 lemons, 6 grated garlic cloves, 1 tbsp dried oregano, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 tsp salt and 1 tsp black pepper together and toss the thighs in it. Let them sit while the oven heats to 425°F.
Spread the thighs on a sheet pan and roast 22 to 25 minutes, until they reach 175°F and the edges brown.
Rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Portion into 9 containers. Fridge 7, freeze 2.
lemon-chicken.tip: Thighs stay juicy all week where breasts dry out, and the lemon and oregano go Greek, Mexican or Southern later on.

roast-med.name: Roasted zucchini, peppers and red onion
steps: Toss the zucchini, bell peppers and red onion with 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tsp dried oregano and 1 tsp salt.
Roast at 425°F for 25 minutes alongside the chicken, stirring halfway.
Cool and store in one container.

lemon-rice.name: Lemon herb rice
steps: Cook the rice with 1 tsp salt and 1 tbsp olive oil.
Fold in the lemon zest, juice and parsley.
Cool and store. It keeps 5 days.

whipped-feta.name: Whipped lemon feta
steps: Mash the feta with a fork until it is almost smooth, or blend it.
Stir in the yogurt, the juice of ½ lemon, the garlic and ½ tsp dried dill until creamy. Season with black pepper.
Keeps 5 days in a jar.
whipped-feta.tip: Salty, tangy and thick enough to spread. It does the job of tzatziki and a cheese sauce at once.

egg-muffins.name: Spinach feta egg muffins

ingredients.qty: ½ of the third pepper, diced

steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and spray 9 muffin cups well.
Whisk the eggs, milk, ½ tsp salt and ¼ tsp black pepper.
Divide the spinach, diced bell pepper, feta and cheddar between the cups and pour the eggs over.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes, until puffed and set.
Cool and refrigerate. Reheat 3 for 45 seconds.

oat-cups.name: Berry banana baked oatmeal cups
steps: Mash the bananas, then whisk in the eggs, milk, 2 tbsp honey, 1 tsp cinnamon and a pinch of salt.
Stir in the oats, raisins and 1 cup of the frozen berry mix.
Divide between 6 sprayed muffin cups.
Bake at 350°F for 22 to 25 minutes, until golden and set.
Eat 3 with a spoon of Greek yogurt or cottage cheese for more protein.

greek-bowl.name: Greek lemon chicken bowl
steps: Pack the lemon rice, roasted zucchini and peppers and lemon chicken in each container, with the cucumber and tomatoes on the side.
Reheat the warm part 2 minutes.
Add the cucumber, tomatoes and a big spoon of whipped feta.
greek-bowl.tip: Friday's comes from the frozen portion you moved to the fridge Wednesday.

avgolemono.name: Avgolemono: Greek lemon chicken rice soup
steps: Soften the onion in 1 tbsp olive oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic for 30 seconds, then 6 cups broth. Bring it to a simmer.
Stir in the lemon rice and shredded lemon chicken and simmer 5 minutes.
Whisk the 2 eggs and the juice of 2 lemons in a bowl. Slowly whisk in 2 ladles of hot broth so the eggs warm up without scrambling.
Turn the heat to low and stir the egg mixture back into the pot. Stir 2 to 3 minutes until the soup turns silky and slightly thick. Do not let it boil.
Finish with 1 tsp dried dill and season with salt and black pepper to taste. Pack 2 bowls for Wednesday and Thursday, and reheat them gently.
avgolemono.tip: This week's new one. The lemon and egg turn the broth creamy with no cream at all.

chipotle-quesadillas.name: Chipotle chicken quesadillas

ingredients.qty: 1 pepper, minced, plus a spoon of sauce

steps: Toss the chicken with the minced chipotle pepper and a spoon of adobo sauce.
Build 2 quesadillas: tortilla, cheddar, chicken, spinach, pickled onions, cheddar, tortilla.
Crisp in a sprayed cast iron over medium, 2 to 3 minutes a side, pressing down.
Cut in quarters and dip in yogurt.
chipotle-quesadillas.tip: Uses up last week's tortillas, cheddar, chipotle and pickled onions.

chicken-gyros.name: Chicken gyros with whipped feta
steps: Crisp the chicken in a hot skillet for 3 minutes with a pinch of oregano.
Warm the pitas in the same pan, 30 seconds a side.
Spread with whipped feta, then fill with chicken, cucumber, tomatoes and pickled onions.
Serve with the roasted zucchini and peppers, warmed.
chicken-gyros.tip: Dinner for two that feels like takeout and takes 15 minutes.

greek-flatbread.name: New Year's Eve Greek chicken flatbreads
steps: Spread the pitas with whipped feta.
Top with the chicken, roasted zucchini and peppers, tomatoes and parmesan.
Air-fry at 380°F for 5 to 6 minutes (or bake at 425°F for 8) until crisp at the edges.
Finish with a pinch of red pepper flakes.
greek-flatbread.tip: A 15-minute New Year's Eve dinner after pickleball.

hoppin-john.name: Hoppin' John with collards and skillet cornbread
hoppin-john.serves: 3 (New Year's dinner for two + Saturday lunch)
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Stir the corn muffin mix, 1 egg and ⅓ cup milk together, pour into a sprayed cast iron and bake 15 to 18 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the ¾ cup rice.

Brown the sausage in 1 tbsp olive oil in a large pot for 4 minutes. Add the onion and the diced half bell pepper for 4 minutes, then the garlic, 1 tsp smoked paprika and a pinch of red pepper flakes for 30 seconds.
Add the collard greens and 1½ cups broth, cover and simmer 10 minutes until tender.
Stir in the black-eyed peas and simmer 5 minutes. Finish with 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar.
Serve over rice with a wedge of cornbread. Pack one bowl for Saturday.
hoppin-john.tip: A Southern New Year's tradition: the peas are for luck and the greens are for money.
